2607.09629.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
2607.09629.paper_summary: Reliable autonomous driving requires full-scene perception that couples foreground objects with dense semantic layout. Recently, 4D millimeter-wave radar has emerged as a robust and affordable sensor, yet its sparse returns make radar-camera fusion necessary for comprehensive scene understanding. Existing radar-camera methods mainly optimize detection, while dual-task systems usually decode boxes and occupancy with limited interaction. To address this gap and advance radar-based multi-task learning, we propose \method, a 4D radar-camera framework for 360$^\circ$ full-scene perception, which models semantic occupancy as a persistent scene state rather than a terminal output. \method{} follows a cross-modal state reasoning paradigm, where the occupancy state is modeled and propagated through stages for coarse-to-fine feature aggregation. Specifically, State-guided BEV Enhancement (SBE) strengthens intra-frame BEV representation, while Doppler-guided Temporal Fusion (DTF) preserves state evidence over longer temporal horizons. Beyond the model, we further extend ManTruckScenes with satellite-map-based generated occupancy labels and pair it with OmniHD-Scenes in a unified cross-dataset detection-and-occupancy protocol. The resulting experiments cover accuracy, robustness, ablation, and efficiency under one radar-camera multi-task evaluation framework. Code and labels will be released upon acceptance.
2607.09629.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的自動駕駛需要全場景感知，將前景物體與密集的語義佈局結合起來。最近，4D 毫米波雷達作為一種穩健且經濟的傳感器出現，但其稀疏的回傳使得雷達-相機融合成為全面場景理解的必要條件。現有的雷達-相機方法主要優化檢測，而雙任務系統通常以有限的互動解碼邊界框和佔用情況。為了填補這一空白並推進基於雷達的多任務學習，我們提出了 \method，一個用於 360$^\circ$ 全場景感知的 4D 雷達-相機框架，該框架將語義佔用建模為持久的場景狀態，而不是終端輸出。 \method{} 遵循跨模態狀態推理範式，其中佔用狀態在階段間建模並傳播，以進行粗到細的特徵聚合。具體而言，狀態引導的 BEV 增強 (SBE) 加強了幀內 BEV 表示，而多普勒引導的時間融合 (DTF) 在更長的時間範圍內保留狀態證據。除了模型之外，我們還進一步擴展了 ManTruckScenes，使用基於衛星地圖生成的佔用標籤，並將其與 OmniHD-Scenes 在統一的跨數據集檢測和佔用協議中配對。所得到的實驗涵蓋了準確性、穩健性、消融和效率，並在一個雷達-相機多任務評估框架下進行。代碼和標籤將在接受後發布。
